description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_SupplierSelection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierSelection">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Issue RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Submit proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Select and onboard supplier" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_SupplierSelection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_NeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Procurement" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueRFP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssessmentMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateTerms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OnboardSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExecuteContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SupplierReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new supplier identified"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals">
      <bpmn:documentation>Evaluate proposals based on cost, quality, and delivery time.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" name="Conduct additional assessment?" default="Flow_AssessmentSkipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductAssessment" name="Conduct site visits or interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" name="Continue assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateTerms" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract (both parties)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalSplit" name="Complete onboarding and execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalJoin" name="Onboarding and execution complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupplierReady" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentSelected" name="Additional assessment selected" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Task_ConductAssessment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>additional_assessment_selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentSkipped" name="No additional assessment" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentDone" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateTerms" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_FinalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalJoin" targetRef="End_SupplierReady"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
